steps.label: Set JellyDrop preset (3x3x3 tetrahedral cube, spawns above the always-on floor)
Precondition: cube spawns at y in [1.5,2.5]

Precondition: initial volume is meaningfully nonzero (JellyBody::getTotalVolume()'s tetrahedra decomposition gives -1/3 for this 1x1x1 cube, not the geometric +1.0 -- sign/scale is an existing characteristic of getTotalVolume(), not something this scenario is asserting on)
Change: the cube has fallen -- min Y after falling is measurably lower than its spawn height
Invariant: volume conserved after falling (XPBD volume constraint, within 5% of -1/3)
